mapper.insert: INSERT INTO COMTNLEADERSCHDUL ( SCHDUL_ID, SCHDUL_NM, SCHDUL_PLACE, SCHDUL_CN, FRST_REGISTER_ID, SCHDUL_BGNDE, SCHDUL_ENDDE, CAL_ID ) VALUES ( #{schdulId}, #{schdulNm}, #{schdulPlace}, #{schdulCn}, #{frstRegisterId}, #{schdulBgnde}, #{schdulEndde}, #{calId} )
mapper.select: SELECT SCHDUL_ID, SCHDUL_NM "title", to_char(to_date(SCHDUL_BGNDE,'yyyymmddHH24miss'),'yyyy-mm-dd"T"HH24:mi:ss')"start" , to_char(to_date(SCHDUL_ENDDE,'yyyymmddHH24miss'),'yyyy-mm-dd"T"HH24:mi:ss')"end", SCHDUL_PLACE, SCHDUL_CN FROM COMTNLEADERSCHDUL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CALENDAR ( CAL_ID, CAL_NAME, COLOR, NOTE, ADD_DE, POST_DE, OWNER_ID ) VALUES ( #{calId}, #{calName}, #{color}, 'test', SYSDATE, SYSDATE, #{ownerId} )
mapper.select: SELECT cal_id, cal_name, color, owner_id FROM CALENDAR ORDER BY cal_name
